nodes.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED
nodes.description: UE is not registered for 5GS services. Initial registration can be initiated from this state.

nodes.name: Event_InitialRegistration_Trigger
nodes.description: Trigger for the UE to initiate the registration procedure for initial registration (e.g., power on, recovery from out of coverage, request for SMS over NAS, emergency services needed, onboarding, disaster roaming, recovery from unavailability).
parameters: UE determined PLMN with disaster condition

nodes.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED
nodes.description: UE has sent a REGISTRATION REQUEST message for initial registration and is waiting for a response from the AMF.

nodes.name: Receive_REGISTRATION_ACCEPT
nodes.description: UE receives REGISTRATION ACCEPT message from the AMF, successfully completing the initial registration.
parameters: UE radio capability ID deletion indication
List of PLMNs to be used in disaster condition

nodes.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED
nodes.description: UE is successfully registered with the network for normal service.

nodes.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE
nodes.description: UE is registered but has limited service, typically due to CAG restrictions or TAI restrictions. UE searches for a suitable cell.

nodes.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH
nodes.description: UE is registered but must perform PLMN selection, typically due to CAG restrictions preventing access in the current cell/PLMN.

nodes.name: Receive_REGISTRATION_REJECT
nodes.description: UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT message from the AMF, indicating failure of the initial registration attempt.

nodes.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-SUPI
nodes.description: UE is deregistered because the network considers the UE or ME illegal, or 5GS services are not allowed. USIM may be considered invalid.

nodes.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH
nodes.description: UE is deregistered and must perform PLMN/SNPN selection due to rejection (e.g., PLMN not allowed, roaming not allowed, CAG restriction, SNPN not authorized, disaster roaming not allowed, no network slices available).

nodes.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE
nodes.description: UE is deregistered and enters limited service mode, typically due to TAI restrictions or CAG restrictions. UE searches for a suitable cell in the current PLMN/SNPN.

nodes.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION
nodes.description: UE is deregistered after a registration attempt failure (e.g., T3510 expiry, lower layer failure, reject cause #22, #62, #79, #81, #82) or abnormal reject. UE may attempt registration again after a backoff timer (T3511 or T3346).

nodes.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE
nodes.description: UE is deregistered and N1 mode is disabled for 3GPP access due to redirection to EPC (Cause #31). UE searches for E-UTRAN cell.

nodes.name: Event_T3510_Expiry
nodes.description: Timer T3510 expires while waiting for REGISTRATION ACCEPT/REJECT.

nodes.name: Event_LowerLayer_Failure
nodes.description: Lower layers indicate a failure or release the NAS signalling connection before REGISTRATION ACCEPT/REJECT is received.

nodes.name: Event_UE_Deregistration_Required
nodes.description: UE needs to perform de-registration while initial registration is ongoing (e.g., USIM removal).

nodes.name: Receive_DEREGISTRATION_REQUEST
nodes.description: UE receives a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message from the network while in 5GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED state (collision).

nodes.name: Event_TAI_Change
nodes.description: The current Tracking Area Identity (TAI) changes before the initial registration procedure is completed (before ACCEPT/REJECT).

nodes.name: Event_Localized_Service_Access_Disallowed
nodes.description: Access for localized services in the current SNPN is no longer allowed (e.g., disabled or validity information not met) during initial registration.

nodes.name: Event_T3511_Expiry
nodes.description: Timer T3511 expires after a registration attempt failure (counter < 5).

nodes.name: Event_T3346_Expiry
nodes.description: Timer T3346 (congestion backoff) expires.

nodes.name: Event_REG_COMPLETE_Tx_Failure
nodes.description: Transmission of REGISTRATION COMPLETE message fails, and the TAI has not changed.

nodes.name: Event_TAI_Change_After_Accept
nodes.description: The current TAI changes after receiving REGISTRATION ACCEPT but before sending REGISTRATION COMPLETE.

nodes.name: Event_Access_Barred
nodes.description: Lower layers indicate access barring before the initial registration procedure starts.

nodes.name: Event_REG_REQUEST_Tx_Failure
nodes.description: Transmission of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message fails.

nodes.name: Event_SOR_Requires_Release
nodes.description: UE receives SOR transparent container in REG ACCEPT, successfully validates it, and attempts service on another PLMN/SNPN requiring local release.

nodes.name: Event_REG_COMPLETE_Tx_Failure_TAI_Change
nodes.description: Transmission of REGISTRATION COMPLETE message fails, and the TAI has changed.

edges.label: Condition: Initial registration trigger met
condition: UE is in 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state
UE needs initial registration for 5GS services OR emergency services OR SMS over NAS OR onboarding OR disaster roaming OR recovery from unavailability
Access attempt is not barred (5.5.1.2.7 b)
Timer T3346 is not running OR UE meets exception criteria (5.5.1.2.7 a)
Timer T3447 is not running OR Follow-on request indicator is not set (5.5.1.2.7 l)

edges.label: Action: Send REGISTRATION REQUEST, Start T3510, Stop T3502/T3511
action: Include 5GS mobile identity (5G-GUTI, SUCI or PEI based on rules)
Include capabilities (5GMM, S1 UE network, UE security capability, etc.)
Include Requested WUS/PEIPS assistance info (if applicable)
Include UE determined PLMN with disaster condition (if applicable)
Start timer T3519 (if SUCI sent and T3519 not running)

edges.label: No Condition
condition: REGISTRATION ACCEPT message received from AMF

edges.label: Action: Reset counters, Store context, Send REG COMPLETE if needed, Enter 5GMM-REGISTERED
condition: Initial registration accepted
No restricting CAG update received OR CAG update allows access on current cell type (non-CAG or allowed CAG)
action: Store Equivalent PLMNs/SNPNs (if received, update forbidden lists)
Store LADN information / Extended LADN information (if received)
Store MICO indication / T3324 / T3512 / non-3GPP de-reg timer (if received)
Store NSSAI info (Allowed, Rejected, Pending, Configured, Partially Allowed/Rejected, NSSRG, Alternative, Time/Location Validity, On-demand) (if received)
Store SOR transparent container (if received and integrity check passes)
Store Operator-defined access category definitions (if received)
Store UE radio capability ID / Handle deletion indication (if received)
Store CAG information list / Extended CAG information list (if received)
Store Network Feature Support (IMS voice, LCS, Emergency, ATSSS, NAPS, MPS/MCS indicators, etc.)
Store RAN timing sync info (if received)
Store RAT utilization control info (if received)
Send REGISTRATION COMPLETE message (if required by received IEs like 5G-GUTI, SOR, NSSAI updates, CAG, PEIPS, UE Radio Cap ID, Truncated 5G-S-TMSI, Service-level-AA pending, On-demand NSSAI, etc.)

edges.label: Condition: CAG update restricts access; Action: Enter LIMITED-SERVICE, Search cell
condition: Initial registration accepted
Received CAG information list indicates current cell is not allowed OR UE is only allowed on CAG cells and current cell is non-CAG
Entry for registered PLMN exists in CAG list
At least one CAG ID is authorized OR indication 'only allowed via CAG cells' is NOT present
action: Perform actions from edge4 (Store context, Reset counters, etc.)
Search for a suitable cell (based on updated CAG info)

edges.label: Condition: CAG update restricts to CAG-only; Action: Enter PLMN-SEARCH
condition: Initial registration accepted
Received CAG information list indicates UE is only allowed on CAG cells
No CAG ID is authorized based on the allowed list for the registered PLMN
Not emergency registration
action: Perform actions from edge4 (Store context, Reset counters, etc.)
Apply PLMN selection process (with updated CAG info)

edges.label: No Condition
condition: REGISTRATION REJECT message received from AMF

edges.label: Condition: Cause #3/#6/#7/#5(Emer); Action: Set status 5U3, Delete context, Enter NO-SUPI
condition: 5GMM cause is #3 (Illegal UE) OR #6 (Illegal ME) OR #7 (5GS services not allowed)
Not initial registration for onboarding services in SNPN (for #3, #7)
OR 5GMM cause is #5 (PEI not accepted) AND registration type is 'emergency registration'
action: Set 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED
Delete 5G-GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list, ngKSI
Consider USIM invalid for 5GS (until power off, removal, or T3245 expiry)
If integrity checked: Set relevant invalid counters to max

edges.label: Condition: Cause #11(3GPP)/#73(3GPP)/#36/#78/#80; Action: Set status 5U3, Delete context, Add forbidden
condition: 5GMM cause is #11 (PLMN not allowed) (3GPP access) OR #73 (Serving network not authorized) (3GPP access) OR #36 (IAB-node operation not authorized) OR #78 (PLMN not allowed at UE location) OR #80 (Disaster roaming not allowed)
action: Set 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED
Delete 5G-GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list, ngKSI
Store PLMN ID in forbidden PLMN list (for #11, #36, #73)
Store PLMN ID and location in 'PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location' list and start timer (for #78)
If integrity checked: Set PLMN-specific attempt counters to max (for #11, #36, #73)
Do not attempt disaster roaming on this PLMN for specific period (for #80)

edges.label: Condition: Cause #12/#13(Option)/#15/#27; Action: Set status 5U3, Delete TAI list, Add forbidden TAI
condition: 5GMM cause is #12 (Tracking area not allowed) OR #15 (No suitable cells in tracking area) OR #13 (Roaming not allowed in this tracking area) (Limited Service Option) OR #27 (N1 mode not allowed)
action: Set 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED
Delete last visited registered TAI, TAI list
Delete 5G-GUTI, ngKSI (if not registered on both accesses or cause #27)
Store current TAI in '5GS forbidden TAs for regional provision of service' (for #12) OR '5GS forbidden TAs for roaming' (for #13, #15)
Disable N1 mode capability for specific access type (for #27)
If integrity checked: Disable N1 mode capability for other access type (for #27)
Search for suitable cell in another TA (for #15)

edges.label: Condition: Cause #22; Action: Set status 5U2, Start T3346
condition: 5GMM cause is #22 (Congestion)
T3346 value IE is present in REGISTRATION REJECT message
T3346 value is not zero and not deactivated
action: Set 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED
Start timer T3346 with the value provided in the T3346 value IE (if integrity protected) or random value from default range (if not integrity protected)

edges.label: Condition: Cause #31; Action: Set status 5U3, Delete context, Disable N1(3GPP)
condition: 5GMM cause is #31 (Redirection to EPC required)
UE indicated support for CIoT optimizations and S1 mode
Received via 3GPP access
action: Set 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED
Delete 5G-GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list, ngKSI
Disable N1 mode capability for 3GPP access

edges.label: Condition: Cause #62(Option)/#79(Option)/#81(Option)/#82(Option); Action: Set status 5U2, Store rejected NSSAI (if #62)
condition: 5GMM cause is #62 (No network slices available) OR #79 (UAS services not allowed) OR #81 (Selected N3IWF not compatible) OR #82 (Selected TNGF not compatible)
UE chooses ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION state
action: Set 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED
Start T3526 backoff timers for rejected S-NSSAIs with cause 'max UEs reached' (for #62)
If #81/#82: May use provided N3IWF/TNAN info for selection before retry; Delete context if new N3IWF/TNAN selected.

edges.label: Condition: Cause #62(Option)/#79(Option)/#81(Option)/#82(Option); Action: Set status 5U2, Store rejected NSSAI (if #62)
condition: 5GMM cause is #62 (No network slices available) OR #79 (UAS services not allowed) OR #81 (Selected N3IWF not compatible) OR #82 (Selected TNGF not compatible)
UE chooses PLMN-SEARCH state
action: Set 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED
Start T3526 backoff timers for rejected S-NSSAIs with cause 'max UEs reached' (for #62)

edges.label: Condition: Cause #72(non-3GPP)/#77(Wireline); Action: Set status 5U3, Delete context
condition: 5GMM cause is #72 (Non-3GPP access to 5GCN not allowed) OR #77 (Wireline access area not allowed)
action: Set 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED
Delete last visited registered TAI, TAI list
Delete 5G-GUTI, ngKSI (if not registered on 3GPP access for #72; always for #77)
Disable N1 mode capability for non-3GPP access (for #72)
If integrity checked: Set non-3GPP attempt counter to max (for #72)

edges.label: Condition: Cause #74(3GPP)/#75(3GPP) (SNPN); Action: Set status 5U3, Delete context, Add forbidden SNPN
condition: 5GMM cause is #74 (Temporarily not authorized for this SNPN) (3GPP access) OR #75 (Permanently not authorized for this SNPN) (3GPP access)
action: Set 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED
Delete 5G-GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list, ngKSI, equivalent SNPN list
Store SNPN ID in 'temporarily forbidden SNPNs' (#74) or 'permanently forbidden SNPNs' (#75) list for 3GPP access
If integrity checked: Set SNPN-specific attempt counters to max

edges.label: Condition: Cause #74(non-3GPP)/#75(non-3GPP) (SNPN); Action: Set status 5U3, Delete context, Add forbidden SNPN
condition: 5GMM cause is #74 (Temporarily not authorized for this SNPN) (non-3GPP access) OR #75 (Permanently not authorized for this SNPN) (non-3GPP access)
action: Set 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED
Delete 5G-GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list, ngKSI, equivalent SNPN list
Store SNPN ID in 'temporarily forbidden SNPNs' (#74) or 'permanently forbidden SNPNs' (#75) list for non-3GPP access
If integrity checked: Set SNPN-specific attempt counters to max

edges.label: Condition: Cause #76 (CAG - PLMN Search Option); Action: Set status 5U3, Update CAG list
condition: 5GMM cause is #76 (Not authorized for this CAG or authorized for CAG cells only)
Received in non-CAG cell OR (Received in CAG cell AND entry indicates 'only allowed via CAG cells' AND no authorized CAG ID remains after update)
action: Set 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED
Update/Store CAG information list (if received or implicitly)
Apply PLMN selection process (with updated CAG info)

edges.label: Condition: Cause #76 (CAG - Limited Service Option); Action: Set status 5U3, Update CAG list
condition: 5GMM cause is #76 (Not authorized for this CAG or authorized for CAG cells only)
Received in CAG cell
Entry does not indicate 'only allowed via CAG cells' OR (Entry indicates 'only allowed via CAG cells' AND at least one authorized CAG ID remains after update) OR No entry for current PLMN exists
action: Set 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED
Update/Store CAG information list (if received or implicitly)
Search for a suitable cell (based on updated CAG info)
